decision: A transcription of SysML 8.2.2.17.4. The clause and the Xtext state this production identically — `ownedRelationship += TriggerFeatureValue` in both — so there is nothing to weigh. It contributes no tokens; the trigger's keyword and argument are below it. The Xtext declares it a fragment, an inlining mechanism of that parser generator rather than a claim about the language.

evidence.note: States the production; the rule is its transcription.
In line 18 `then accept sig after 10[SI::s];` this production holds `after 10[SI::s]`; in line 22 `then accept when b.f;` it holds `when b.f`.
Second opinion. Identical to the clause.
